description: This file defines the Java interface 'ModifyAttributeLiveCommand' which extends multiple interfaces to provide live command capabilities for modifying attributes in a specific context. It includes methods to retrieve the JSON pointer of the attribute to modify and the new value to set.

classes.name: ModifyAttributeLiveCommand
classes.description: An interface representing a live command to modify an attribute, providing access to the attribute's JSON pointer and value, and inheriting behavior for live commands and thing modifications.

methods.name: getAttributePointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer indicating the location of the attribute to be modified.

methods.name: getAttributeValue
methods.description: Returns the value that the attribute should be set to.
